title: Decide whether a rank-one target gap survives arbitrarily many uncoupled replicas
statement: Let E be simple isolated in a true reducing sector K,with nonempty complementary spectrum S at distance delta>0 from0. The tensor-product target has inf_N Delta_N>0 iff S is one-sided; then Delta_N=delta. Two-sided S gives Delta_N->0. One opposite-sign spectral point plus an interval already gives finite-copy essential-spectrum overlap.

requires: Actual common reducing sector,a simple isolated target,nonempty complement and delta>0
For a positive certificate:a proved one-sided bound on the complete complement;for an obstruction:proved opposite-sign spectral points or a point and opposite-sign interval in that same complement
provides: Exact rank-one rather than energy-value uniform gap criterion
Finite-copy overlap test from a point and an opposite-sign interval
assumptions: One convenient source-vector spectral density does not define the reducing sector
Spectral overlap alone is not decay
Unrestricted perturbation converse may be nonlocal N-body; local restricted couplers need their own analysis
costs: To infer uniform perturbation stability,control total norm v<delta/2 independently of N
N-independent gap is for the chosen branch,not automatically the entire logical code
contract.units: hbar=B=1,source-local energy/time and stated amplitude versus population conventions; no automatic device-unit conversion
contract.obstruction: Do not infer scalable protection from single-unit parity gaps or bounded per-edge interactions.

input_slots.description: Actual signed complement spectrum,or proved point/interval witnesses,on the true common reducing sector. A missing witness remains an obligation.

evidence.range_scope: Complete mixed-interval proof,tensor-sum iff criterion,finite-copy point/interval corollary and precise accessible/total-norm scope.
Completed owner reconstruction of the spectrum decomposition,Diophantine cancellation and norm-class boundary.

body: Actual complete source argument and scoped review govern this unit. No physical input,program execution,priority or advantage is acquired by extraction.
